title: PIS/PASEP Validator
description: Check PIS, PASEP, NIS, or NIT check digits locally in the browser without querying official Brazilian systems.
metaDescription: Check PIS, PASEP, NIS, or NIT check digits locally in the browser without querying official Brazilian systems.

form.title: Validate PIS/PASEP
form.description: Type or paste one 11-digit Brazilian worker or social identifier to check its public modulo-11 check digit.

input.title: Identifier
input.label: PIS, PASEP, NIS, or NIT
input.privacy: Validation runs in your browser. This tool does not put the identifier in the live URL or send it to the server.
input.hint: Use one number at a time. Dots, slash, hyphen, and spaces are ignored as visual separators.

share.title: Share
share.description: By default, the shared link contains only the tool route.
share.includeContent: Include identifier in the shared link
share.safe: The current link does not include the typed identifier.
share.publicWarning: Links with an identifier expose it to anyone who receives the URL.
share.tooLong: The typed content cannot be included safely. The link will include only the content flag.

result.title: Result
result.description: The result shows local format and check-digit consistency, not official registration or eligibility.
result.emptyDescription: Enter a number to start the local check.
result.validDescription: The final digit matches the public modulo-11 convention used for this identifier family.
result.invalidChecksumDescription: The final digit does not match the expected modulo-11 check digit.
result.incompleteDescription: Use exactly 11 ASCII digits for PIS, PASEP, NIS, or NIT syntax.
result.normalizedHint: Only ASCII digits are kept after removing accepted visual separators.
result.formattedHint: Display mask used by this tool: 000.00000.00-0.
result.checkDigitValue: Provided digit: {provided}. Expected digit by the modulo-11 convention: {expected}.
result.checkDigitUnavailable: Unavailable until the input has 11 valid digits and no format issue.

explanation.empty: This is a local typing-check tool for an 11-digit identifier shape.
explanation.incomplete: There are not enough digits yet to calculate the expected check digit.
explanation.invalidFormat: Fix unsupported characters, length, or repeated sequences before interpreting the check digit.
explanation.invalidChecksum: The check digit does not match; there may be a typo or this may not be a supported identifier.
explanation.validChecksum: The check digit matches. This does not prove official registration, account status, benefit eligibility, balance, or employment record.

repeated.label: Repeated sequence

issues.empty: There is no identifier to validate yet.
issues.trimmedWhitespace: Leading or trailing spaces were ignored for validation.
issues.unsupportedCharacters: Remove letters, unsupported punctuation, emoji, or non-ASCII digits.
issues.incompleteLength: Use exactly 11 digits for this identifier family.
issues.tooLong: The identifier has more than 11 digits.
issues.repeatedDigits: Sequences where all digits are identical are rejected.
issues.checksumUnavailable: The check digit cannot be calculated while there is a format or length issue.
issues.invalidChecksum: The final digit does not match what the modulo-11 convention expects.
issues.validChecksum: The final digit matches what the modulo-11 convention expects.

summary.scope: Scope: local format and check-digit check only; no official lookup.

details.title: What this validation covers
details.description: The tool checks deterministic local rules only and avoids external services.

checksum.title: Modulo-11 check digit
checksum.description: Applies weights 3, 2, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, and 2 to the first 10 digits.

format.title: 11-digit format
format.description: Accepts ASCII digits and simple visual separators, then shows a 000.00000.00-0 mask.

noLookup.title: No official lookup
noLookup.description: Does not query gov.br, Caixa, Banco do Brasil, INSS, Dataprev, CNIS, FGTS, or Abono systems.

privacy.title: Private by default
privacy.description: The live URL and default shared link omit the identifier; prefilled links require an explicit fragment-only option.

lookup.question: Does this consult gov.br, Caixa, Banco do Brasil, INSS, or Dataprev?
lookup.answer: No. It runs only a local format and check-digit calculation in the browser.

eligibility.question: Does a valid check digit prove benefit eligibility?
eligibility.answer: No. It does not prove registration, account status, balance, employment record, PIS/PASEP payment, or Abono Salarial eligibility.

terms.question: What are PIS, PASEP, NIS, and NIT?
terms.answer: They are Brazilian worker or social identification contexts that commonly use an 11-digit number. This tool treats them only as an 11-digit checksum shape.

privacy.question: Is the number sent to the server?
privacy.answer: Not by this tool. The calculation runs in the browser and the live URL omits the identifier.

sharing.question: Can I share a prefilled link?
sharing.answer: Yes, only after enabling the explicit option. The identifier is placed in the URL fragment, then removed from the address bar after hydration.

seo.about: The PIS/PASEP validator checks whether an 11-digit PIS, PASEP, NIS, or NIT-like value is internally consistent with a public modulo-11 check-digit convention. It is not an official registry, benefits, balance, or account lookup.
seo.howToUse: Type or paste one identifier, review the status, expected check digit, and checklist, then copy the normalized or formatted value if needed. Use the result only as a typing aid before checking official channels when official status matters.
